    - card_about_to_expire: Customer's card is nearing its expiry date and they need a replacement.
    - card_arrival: Customer is asking whether their ordered card has arrived or when it will.
    - card_delivery_estimate: Customer wants an estimated delivery date for a card they ordered.
    - card_linking: Customer wants to link a card to their account or a payment app.
    - get_disposable_virtual_card: Customer wants to obtain a one-time-use virtual card.
